_note: FEINTFIX2 G1 (S567) - THE FEINTING HAND DOES NOT GUARD FIRST (the Claude player's finding): in a beat where your lead hand feints, that hand guards nothing in the moments BEFORE its own feint moment (today it is 'still up' until its own moment). Nothing else changes.

const cov = [0, 1].map((k) => { const c = {}; if (f[k].g <= 0) return c; const leadAway = act[k] === 'lead' || (P[k].lead === 'feint' && P[k].ord.indexOf('lead') > i); if (!leadAway) c[COVER[P[k].hl][0]] = 1; if (act[k] !== 'rear') c[COVER[P[k].hr][1]] = 1; return c; }), stun = [0, 0];
